objects.prompt: A simple wooden food preparation table for a Vietnamese restaurant kitchen, viewed from a high top-down angle. Place a round wooden cutting board clearly in the center of the tabletop. Arrange a few simple fresh ingredients around the cutting board, such as vegetables, herbs, and raw meat, neatly organized for cooking. Clean rectangular wooden table, practical kitchen design, clean 2D pixel art, low top-down RPG style, simple shading. No characters, no cooked food, no stove.
